_comment: Port forwards added to the managed Host block by Open in VS Code.
Compiled into the binary at build time — edit and rebuild to change.
environments: keyed by the instance's MMODAL_ENV tag (case-insensitive).
ip   loopback address bound locally. Used only when the machine's
hosts file has no entry for `host` — where it does, that IP wins,
so an existing hosts setup needs no change.
host remote DNS name, resolved on the bastion.
port optional; omit to infer from the name via port_rules.
port_rules are checked in order and the FIRST match wins, so a name like
kafka-postgres-proxy takes the port of whichever rule is listed first.
The hosts file is only ever read. Where a name has no hosts entry the
tunnel still works, addressed by its IP; the dialog offers the line to
paste in so the name resolves in a browser too.
